subject: Northbridge production: elevated latency + 5xx spike in eastus2 (needs failover)
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@northbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Urgent: sudden latency/500 spike in eastus2 impacting inference jobs

Marissa —

We just started a scheduled job at 08:00 PDT and are seeing a sharp degradation across our inference endpoints backed by eastus2. Symptoms:
- 3x baseline latency for token generation (p95 from ~220ms -> ~700ms)
- 5xx rate ~12% across /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints
- Throughput falling off (request queueing) causing timeouts on our batch pipelines

This is production and affecting customer-facing sessions. We opened a PagerDuty earlier (PD INC NB-5921) but wanted to message you directly — our SRE says it looks region-tier. Can you confirm if Redwood has any region-level events or routing changes? Please advise immediate mitigation and whether we can be routed to westus2 while you investigate.

Attaching a screenshot of the Northbridge dashboard and a small log excerpt.

— Emily
Emily Park
Director, Platform Engineering | Northbridge
emily.park@northbridge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@northbridge.com>
Cc: Northbridge Ops <ops@northbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: sudden latency/500 spike in eastus2 impacting inference jobs

Thanks Emily — I see the PagerDuty and I'm on it. Im escalating to our on-call and the infra lead now. Initial ask: can you share a sample request-id from a failing call (X-Request-Id) and confirm the affected routes (was it just /v1/generate and /v1/chat or others)?

Immediate actions from our side (Im pushing to get these started now):
- PagerDuty escalation to infra on-call + follow the region disaster checklist
- Validate whether traffic is eligible for automated cross-region evacuation to westus2 and, if so, prime the cache there
- Temporarily enable degraded-mode micro-batching (reduces token-parallelism but may lower error rate)

If we can move a portion of your requests to westus2 for the next 60m well monitor for errors/regressions and then fail back if healthy. Ill loop in Rishi and Jonas internally for routing + cache work. Can you join a quick 15-min call at :35?

Attachments: nb_error_dashboard.png

— Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Success (Edge & Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Northbridge — escalate & immediate cross-region play (eastus2)

Team — Northbridge reporting a 5xx/latency surge in eastus2 affecting production. Customer is already paging and asking to evacuate to westus2. Summary: 12% 500s, p95 ~700ms, throughput collapse. Customer impact is urgent (scheduled jobs + live sessions).

Please treat as P1. Proposed play:
1) Confirm: are there any active deployments or infra changes in eastus2 that match the window (08:00 PDT)? Jonas, check cluster autoscaler and any recent kernel/hotpatch ops.
2) Routing: if route policy allows, start a partial traffic shift (10-25%) to westus2 for read-only inference routes. Use routing policy: region-preferred fallback -> westus2, keep token-bucket limits for safety.
3) Cache & KV: prime KV cache in westus2 with hot prefixes for the last 30m of traffic to avoid cold misses.
4) Degraded mode: enable micro-batching and reduce max-new-tokens cap for migrated traffic to avoid timeouts.
5) Communication: Naomi, prepare a short customer-facing note confirming we're initiating failover and expected next updates at +30m and +60m.

Deliverables / owners:
- Jonas: validate cluster health and initiate traffic shift when ready (ETA 12m)
- Rishi: prepare cache priming job and degraded-mode flags (ETA 10m)
- Naomi: draft external comms and join run-call (ETA 8m)

I'm standing up a short run-call at :35 — link in PD. If any of the checks fail, fallback to throttling policy and continue investigation. Quote from Emily below for reference.

On it — quick notes from infra side:
- No hotpatches scheduled in eastus2 at 07:50-08:10 local. No rolling nodes at that window.
- Preliminary traces show a spike in KV contention on the model cache layer around 08:02 which correlates to increased tail latency and queueing. Suspect a region-local cache eviction thrash amplified by a traffic spike.

Plan going forward (executing now):
1) Initiate partial traffic shift (20%) to westus2 for /v1/generate and /v1/chat using routing tier "regional-fallback". Jonas, I pushed the route update to staging; please promote to production when youre ready. Command: ./routectl promote --policy regional-fallback --percent 20 --from eastus2 --to westus2
2) Cache prime: running cache-prime job to seed hot keys from last 30m. Job ID: cp-NB-78 (link in PD).
3) Metrics: enabling additional tracing and raising error alert thresholds to avoid alert storms while we stabilize.

Emily — Ill PM you the failing request IDs (first batch attached) and share mid-point updates at +15m. If error rate drops below 2% for the migrated portion after 20 minutes we can increase shift to 50%.
